quit.title: Quit Squat Souls?
quit.confirm: The current session stops: the sets to do are dropped and unused jokers are lost, the sets done stay in the history.

about.description: Squat Souls turns your games into a workout: boss down, missed jump, rage-inducing game over, you pay in bodyweight exercises before picking the controller back up. The harsher the game, the stronger you get. Prepare to squat.
about.disclaimer: Squat Souls is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher. Game names belong to their respective owners.

safety.title: Safety advice
lines: If in doubt about your health, ask a doctor.
A few reps done well beat many done badly.
Split long sets, respect the breaks and drink water.

intro.title: Squat Souls
lines: Something happens in your game: a few bodyweight exercises, then back to the controller.

yourProgram.title: Craft your build
lines: You fill in the program. The exercises already there are only examples: adjust them to your level before you start.

gitGud.title: No need to git gud
lines: Skill issue? Not here. The exercises don't punish playing badly, they just give you a good reason to get up from your chair.
Doing more than planned unlocks no achievement. Getting stronger means resting too.
Stuck on a boss? No need to rage quit: it's okay to take a break, you'll come back in better shape.
